description: Keycloak 16 and Keycloak 26 missing-natives census — the delta over the empty HelloWorld baseline. Entries and modules are sorted so the file is byte-stable for committing as a baseline.

capture_notes.capture_method: rustjvm --dump-missing-natives + --XX:AuditMissingNatives on both KC16 (jboss-modules.jar -mp modules) and KC26 (lib/quarkus-run.jar), JDK 21.0.6, --Xmx 1g, 120s budget per target
capture_notes.capture_limitation: Session 87: RustJVM reaches JDK bootstrap (KC26 loads ~377 classes through java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger <clinit>, KC16 stalls inside StringUTF16 <clinit>) and then stops making progress. External SIGTERM / TerminateProcess discards the audit log because the dump is written only on natural Rust main() return — there is no signal handler wired up. The dynamic audit never produced a populated JSON on Session 87 for either KC target. The entries below are therefore sourced from (a) the 9 static ACC_NATIVE 'NativeBridge 9 unregistered' startup warning which is deterministic across every KC boot and (b) one additional historical dynamic finding from /tmp/kc16_stderr.txt (2026-04-24T00:47:03Z) that has since been addressed by registering StringUTF16.isBigEndian.

baseline_files.bench/missing-natives.json: empty {} baseline, captures HelloWorld which invokes no missing natives

capture_notes.sibling_agents: N1 .. N4 fix the 9 static MISSING natives in parallel with this census.

kc16.boot_depth: hangs inside java/lang/StringUTF16.<clinit> / AccessController.doPrivileged during bootstrap classloader phase 1

missing_natives.name: getProtectionDomain0
missing_natives.notes: B6-swallow candidate; ProtectionDomain is null in a VM without SecurityManager.

missing_natives.name: getSigners
missing_natives.notes: B6-swallow; signers array may be null.

missing_natives.name: sleep0
missing_natives.notes: If KC schedules a retry loop (e.g. Narayana, Infinispan), Thread.sleep is on the critical path. A Thread.sleep0 that never sleeps spins the CPU.

missing_natives.name: ensureMaterializedForStackWalk
missing_natives.notes: No-op works; only matters for StackWalker with materialize option.

missing_natives.name: getInheritedAccessControlContext
missing_natives.notes: Returning null is compatible with no-SecurityManager.

missing_natives.name: getProtectionDomain
missing_natives.notes: Returning null is compatible with no-SecurityManager; KC doesn't enforce.

missing_natives.name: getStackAccessControlContext
missing_natives.notes: Returning null is compatible; AccessController.doPrivileged short-circuits.

missing_natives.name: VMSupportsCS8
missing_natives.notes: AtomicLong uses VMSupportsCS8 to pick between CAS and locked impl. x86_64/aarch64 support 8-byte CAS, so returning true unblocks the entire java.util.concurrent.atomic tree — blocked without this on any JDK 21 class that has a long field used with CAS. Required by ConcurrentHashMap, StampedLock, Phaser, ForkJoinTask counters, AtomicLongFieldUpdater.

kc26.boot_depth: loads 377 classes through java/util/concurrent/atomic/AtomicInteger.<clinit> (timestamped 2026-04-24T02:54:34Z, kc26_d12_stderr.txt) then stalls before reaching Quarkus entry point or user servlets

shared.description: Exact intersection of kc16 and kc26 missing-natives — the 9 startup-static entries are identical across both targets because both run on the same JDK 21.0.6 bootstrap classpath.

historical_resolved.name: isBigEndian
historical_resolved.resolution: native-builtins/src/lang_string.rs:3011 registers native_string_utf16_is_big_endian returning target-endian constant; wired via register_string_utf16_natives in lib.rs:2073 and lang_string.rs:3760.
historical_resolved.notes: First real-time dynamic find during an earlier KC16 boot. Now registered, so does not resurface in Session 87 captures.

top_call_count: NOT AVAILABLE — the MissingNativeEntry struct in vm/src/vm/vm_init.rs stores class_name, method_name, descriptor, and sample_call_site; it has no call_count field. The registration logic in record_missing_native deduplicates by (class,name,descriptor) before push, so at most one entry exists per missing signature regardless of how many times it was invoked.

fix_order_recommended.rationale: Blocking. Gates the entire java.util.concurrent.atomic.Atomic*Field/Atomic*Array tree. Must return true on x86_64/aarch64. Trivial one-liner. Assigned to Agent N4.

Blocking. KC boot, Narayana, Infinispan, and Quarkus runtime all call Thread.sleep during retry loops, scheduled executors, parking. Stub must actually sleep (park_timeout) — a no-op will spin the CPU and deadlock supervisor threads. Assigned to Agent N2.

Called by AccessController.doPrivileged which is pervasive in JDK classloader, Jackson, Hibernate, Nashorn. Returning null is JDK-compatible when no SecurityManager is installed (the default). Assigned to Agent N3.
Called from Thread constructor's inherit-ACC path. Null is safe.
No-op works; only matters for StackWalker(Option.MATERIALIZE_FRAMES).
Returning null is compatible. Assigned to Agent N1.

follow_ups: Re-run this census after N1..N4 land and the VM actually progresses past AtomicInteger <clinit>; expect a deeper wave of natives from Unsafe, Reference, VarHandle, Jackson's MethodHandle-based deserialization, and Quarkus classloader intrinsics.
Add a --shutdown-after-seconds N CLI flag (or a SIGTERM handler via ctrlc crate) so a hung boot can still dump the audit log — this would immediately upgrade the capture quality.

Investigate the KC26 boot stall at AtomicInteger <clinit>; may or may not be caused by AtomicLong.VMSupportsCS8 returning an implausible value today (it currently throws UnsatisfiedLinkError when called).
